high: IMPLEMENTATION_FLOW_DIVERGENCE: The approved design requires all three group cards and status icons to remain visible and each commit to immediately show that group's success/failure before advancing. The implementation renders only the current group's two data cards and advances immediately without displaying the committed group's result. The QA check named 'committing resolves the current group immediately' is vacuous for this requirement: it only searches for setResults and groupWin.

STALE_OLD_MECHANIC_CONTENT: Child-visible content still references the removed bath stage, and the hotel experience still supplies school-trip-hotel.jpg even though the approved design explicitly prohibits that old-mechanic image because it depicts room-grid placement and bath-time scheduling.
medium: DESIGN_GROUP_ID_DRIFT: The approved design specifies 花組・月組・星組 (hana/tsuki/hoshi), while the implementation substitutes 雪組 (yuki) without an approved design revision. This does not change scoring or the profession model, but contradicts the claim of exact structural parity.

QA_REGRESSIONS_OVERCLAIM_COVERAGE: Several source-text checks do not establish what their names claim. In particular, the retry check merely detects setResults and groupWin, the rest-need check ignores schoolTrip.ts and registry content, and the reflection-context check only checks for three tokens rather than proving all member records render. Manual review confirms the core gates despite these weak checks.
low: STALE_REGISTRY_COMMENT: The hotel_receive registry comment still describes the removed room→meal→bath three-stage mechanic.

failure_codes.finding: The playing view omits the approved persistent three-group cards/status icons and does not present the required immediate per-group success or failure reaction after commit; it silently advances to the next group.
Child-visible lens copy still says 部屋・食事・入浴, and hotel-trip still references the expressly prohibited old-mechanic school-trip-hotel image.
Implementation changes the approved third group from 星組/hoshi to 雪組/yuki while claiming exact parity.

The harness's single-shot/immediate-resolution assertion only verifies that the commit function contains setResults and groupWin, so it would pass even if an actual same-group retry path or missing immediate visual reaction existed.
